label: ProductForge-Dashboard Backlog 95
title: Agent capability-binding view (per-agent prompt + knowledge/skills/MCP/domain/business bindings)
body:
## Original (as captured)
Read-only view of each agent's role prompt and its bound knowledge/skills/MCP/domain/business capabilities. Extends the Knowledge & Skills browser.

## Context (from linked item product_forge:BI-0123)
For EVERY agent in the pipeline (existing + the new/promoted ones from BI-0113), define and wire:
1) ROLE-APPROPRIATE PROMPT/INSTRUCTIONS authored per agent using the agent-card structure (.opencode/agent/<id>.md + agents/<id>.agent.json): ROLE, decides / does-NOT, inputs, outputs, rules, workflow, artifacts, quality checks, state updates - NOT a generic stub.
2) CAPABILITY BINDING MATRIX per agent -> knowledge base (core/domain_research, core/knowledge_compiler), skills (core/skills_registry, core/skill_contracts), MCP servers (drawio, openflowkit + any domain MCP), DOMAIN skills, and BUSINESS skills (core/business_skills_selector + the business-models KB BI-0119).
3) The binding is declared in config (a per-agent capability map), validated, exposed API-first (BI-0122), and surfaced read-only in the dashboard (Knowledge & Skills browser).
Outcome: no agent runs without its role prompt and its required knowledge/skills/MCP bindings resolved.
API-FIRST (owner convention): expose this capability through the backend API with a stable contract; the dashboard consumes ONLY the API (no direct store access/writes).
